title: Bitcoin mining pool once handling 2.3% of network shuts after hashrate falls 65%
reason: A mining pool that once held 2.3% of network hashrate shutting down is a concrete infrastructure change with specific figures and a deadline.

sources.summary: Computing power directed at Binance Pool has fallen from 26 EH/s in December to about 9 EH/s. Its remaining miners must choose another provider before a Nov. 10 cutoff.

title: EBA designates Circle’s USDC as the EU’s first ‘significant’ e-money token
reason: A formal EBA regulatory designation of USDC as the EU's first 'significant' e-money token is a publishable regulatory milestone with clear supervisory consequences starting Nov. 12.

sources.summary: The EBA classified Circle’s USDC as the EU’s first "significant" e-money token, with new supervisory responsibilities beginning Nov. 12.
